description: No Makefile, task runner, package manifest or native toolchain file. The only place a command is defined is the CI workflow, so CI becomes the authoritative source and must be cited by path. The workflow also runs markdownlint, so doc CI is present.

base_commit..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: markdownlint README.md
      - run: bash scripts/deploy.sh --dry-run
